tips_text:
{{Navigation}}

* This card can be easily [[Synchro Summon]]ed with "[[Windwitch - Ice Bell]]". By using its effect, it can [[Special Summon]] itself from the [[hand]] and "[[Windwitch - Glass Bell]]" from the [[Deck]].
** "Glass Bell" can add "[[Windwitch - Snow Bell]]" to the hand, which can Summon itself, and then be used with this card to Synchro Summon "[[Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon]]". This will place this card in the [[GY]], from where it can use its effect to shuffle an opponent's card into the Deck.
* "[[Firewall Dragon Darkfluid - Neo Tempest Terahertz]]" can send this card from the [[Extra Deck]] to the GY in order to gain ATK and an additional attack.
